question: Having or showing both good and bad feelings
explanation: Ambivalent is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: उभयभावी; किसी चीज के बारे में दोहरे भाव रखने वाला. Example: “She felt ambivalent about leaving her hometown.”

question: One who has the qualities like shyness and openness at the same time
explanation: Ambivert is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: अन्तर्मुखी और बहिर्मुखी दोनों प्रवृत्तियों वाला. Example: “An ambivert can enjoy both social gatherings and quiet time.”

question: Walk or move at a slow, relaxed pace // To walk aimlessly
explanation: Amble is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: धीमी गति में चलना. Example: “We decided to amble through the park after lunch.”

question: Make something bad or unsatisfactory better
explanation: Ameliorate is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: बेहतर बनाने के लिए सुधार करना. Example: “The new measures may ameliorate the shortage of water.”

question: Readily reacting to suggestions and influences // willing to be guided or controlled
explanation: Amenable is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: आज्ञाकारी; आसानी से प्रभावित/नियंत्रित होने वाला. Example: “The manager was amenable to our suggestions.”

question: Someone who is friendly and good natured
explanation: Amicable is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: मैत्रीपूर्ण/सौहार्दपूर्ण. Example: “The two neighbours reached an amicable agreement.”

question: In a friendly and peaceable manner
explanation: Amicably is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: मैत्रीपूर्ण तरीके से. Example: “They settled the dispute amicably.”

question: A partial or total loss of memory
explanation: Amnesia is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: भूलने की बीमारी. Example: “The accident caused temporary amnesia.”

question: An official pardon // the formal act of liberating someone
explanation: Amnesty is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: राज-क्षमा. Example: “The government declared amnesty for certain offenders.”

question: Not following any moral rules and not caring about right/wrong
explanation: Amoral is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: नीतिहीन/अनीतिक. Example: “The character is portrayed as completely amoral.”

question: Animal that can live both on land and in water
explanation: Amphibians is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: उभयचर जन्तु. Example: “Frogs are amphibians because they can live on land and in water.”

question: A person who has had one or more limbs removed
explanation: Amputee is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: अंगहीन/छिन्नांग व्यक्ति. Example: “The amputee learned to walk with a prosthetic limb.”

question: A word or a phrase formed by rearranging a different word
explanation: Anagram is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: शब्द बदलकर नया शब्द बनाना. Example: ““Listen” is an anagram of “Silent”.”

question: A similarity between like features of two things, on which a comparison may be based
explanation: Analogy is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: समानता. Example: “The teacher explained the concept by using an analogy.”

question: Detailed examination of something complex
explanation: Analysis is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: विश्लेषण. Example: “A careful analysis of the data revealed the error.”

question: A person who believes that laws and governments are not necessary // A person who believes in or tries to bring about a state of lawlessness
explanation: Anarchist is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: अराजकतावादी. Example: “The book describes an anarchist who rejects centralized government.”

question: A situation in a country, an organization, etc. in which there is no government, order/control
explanation: Anarchy is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: अव्यवस्था/अराजकता. Example: “The sudden collapse of authority led to anarchy.”

question: The branch of science concerned with the bodily structure of humans, animals, and other living organisms
explanation: Anatomy is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: शरीर रचना विज्ञान. Example: “Students study human anatomy in medical school.”

question: A person who presents a radio/television programme
explanation: Anchor is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: रेडियो/टेलीविजन कार्यक्रम प्रस्तुत करने वाला. Example: “The anchor introduced the evening news.”

question: Belonging to long past
explanation: Ancient is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: प्राचीन. Example: “The museum contains ancient sculptures.”

question: A short, interesting or amusing story about a real person or an event
explanation: Anecdote is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: लघुकथा. Example: “He shared a funny anecdote about his school days.”

question: A medical specialist who administers drugs for relieving pain during surgery
explanation: Anesthetist is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: शल्य चिकित्सा के दौरान दर्द निवारक दवा देने वाला विशेषज्ञ. Example: “The anesthetist monitored the patient during surgery.”

question: Like a weak old woman
explanation: Anile is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: कमजोर वृद्ध महिला के समान. Example: “The novel describes an anile character whose strength has declined with age.”

question: A strong dislike/hostility
explanation: Animosity is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: घृणा/शत्रुता. Example: “Years of rivalry created deep animosity between the two groups.”

question: To destroy completely
explanation: Annihilate is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: पूरी तरह नष्ट करना. Example: “The explosion could annihilate the entire structure.”

question: The date on which an event happened in a previous year
explanation: Anniversary is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: वार्षिक उत्सव/वर्षगांठ. Example: “They celebrated their tenth wedding anniversary.”

question: A fixed sum paid annually
explanation: Annuity is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: वार्षिकी. Example: “She receives a fixed annuity every year.”

question: Departure from common rule
explanation: Anomaly is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: असामान्यता/विसंगति. Example: “The unusually low temperature was an anomaly for that season.”

question: A person whose name is not known // An unknown author
explanation: Anonymous is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: बेनाम/गुमनाम. Example: “An anonymous donor contributed money to the school.”

question: Obsessive desire to lose weight by refusing to eat
explanation: Anorexia is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: भोजन न करने से वजन घटाने की विकृत इच्छा. Example: “The patient was treated for anorexia.”

question: A collection of poems, stories, etc. that have been written by different people and published together in a book
explanation: Anthology is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: संकलन. Example: “The editor published an anthology of modern poems.”

question: One who studies the evolution of mankind
explanation: Anthropologist is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: मानवशास्त्री. Example: “The anthropologist studied the customs of the community.”

question: The study of human race, especially of its origin, development, customs and beliefs
explanation: Anthropology is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: मानवशास्त्र. Example: “Anthropology examines human societies and cultures.”

question: A medicine to nullify the effect of poison
explanation: Antidote is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: जहर के प्रभाव को निष्प्रभावी करने वाली औषधि. Example: “The doctor administered an antidote to the victim.”

question: Strong dislike between two persons // A deep-seated feeling of aversion
explanation: Antipathy is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: घृणा, विरोध. Example: “There was mutual antipathy between the rival groups.”

question: The exact opposite
explanation: Antithesis is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: विपरीतार्थक/विलोम. Example: “Her calm manner was the antithesis of his aggressive behaviour.”

question: Words which are opposite in meaning
explanation: Antonyms is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: विलोम शब्द. Example: ““Hot” and “cold” are antonyms.”

question: A policy that segregates people on the basis of racial discrimination
explanation: Apartheid is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: नस्लीय भेदभाव की नीति. Example: “The history lesson covered the apartheid system.”

question: A set of rooms forming one residence in a building
explanation: Apartment is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: फ्लैट/अपार्टमेंट. Example: “They rented a two-bedroom apartment.”

question: Showing or feeling no interest, enthusiasm or concern
explanation: Apathetic is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: उदासीन. Example: “The apathetic student showed no interest in the discussion.”

question: The feeling of not being interested in or enthusiastic about something
explanation: Apathy is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: उदासीनता. Example: “His apathy toward the issue worried his friends.”

question: Loss of speech due to medical problem
explanation: Aphasia is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: वाक्-क्षमता का ह्रास. Example: “After the stroke, he developed aphasia.”

question: A place where bees are kept
explanation: Apiary is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: मधुमक्खियों के रखने का स्थान. Example: “The farmer keeps hundreds of bees in the apiary.”

question: To express regret for something that one has done wrong
explanation: Apologize is the correct one-word substitution. हिंदी: क्षमा माँगना/खेद व्यक्त करना. Example: “You should apologize for your mistake.”
